Hugging Face Trending Models Digest 2026-08-19

Source: Hugging Face Hub | 30 models | Generated: 2026-08-19 00:34 UTC

Hugging Face Trending Models Digest | August 19, 2026

Based on top 30 trending models sorted by weekly likes

1. Today's Highlights

Qwen’s Qwen3.8-27B tops this week’s trending list with 11,127 weekly likes, leading a wave of new multimodal and MoE model releases from the Qwen ecosystem. Moonshot’s Kimi-K3 multimodal model follows closely with 10,826 likes and 2.2M+ downloads, emerging as a strong competitor in the vision-language space. MiniMax’s MiniMax-H3 video generation model dominates download volumes, with its official release and ComfyUI-optimized variant combining for over 17M total downloads amid surging demand for open video tools. The list also features a robust slate of community fine-tunes and quantizations of Qwen3.8-27B, plus the debut of Meta’s 30B-parameter Muse-Glimmer multimodal model in the top 10 by likes.

2. Trending Models

🧠 Language Models (LLMs, chat models, instruction-tuned)

  • deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
    Author: deepseek-ai | Likes: 3,527 | Downloads: 2,123,462
    High-throughput lightweight conversational text LLM from DeepSeek’s V4 family, optimized for fast inference. Trending as the top-performing open text LLM by likes and downloads, balancing speed and strong conversational quality.
  • Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B
    Author: Qwen | Likes: 1,066 | Downloads: 11,212
    Flagship sparse MoE text generation LLM with 2.4T total parameters and 95B active parameters, part of the Qwen3.8 lineup. Trending as Qwen’s latest frontier open LLM, delivering top-tier reasoning performance with lower active compute costs.
  • deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813
    Author: deepseek-ai | Likes: 601 | Downloads: 30,985
    High-capacity conversational text LLM from DeepSeek’s V4 Pro 0813 build, optimized for complex reasoning tasks. Trending as a top open alternative to closed-source frontier LLMs for advanced reasoning and coding use cases.
  • nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4
    Author: nvidia | Likes: 322 | Downloads: 269,372
    30B-parameter sparse MoE text LLM from NVIDIA’s Nemotron 3.5 family, quantized to NVFP4 for optimized NVIDIA hardware inference. Trending for its strong performance-per-watt and tight integration with NVIDIA’s AI software stack.
  • inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-tiny
    Author: inclusionAI | Likes: 319 | Downloads: 9,990
    Compact conversational text generation model with custom code, optimized for low-resource and edge deployment. Trending as a lightweight open LLM option for on-device and embedded AI applications.

🎨 Multimodal & Generation (image, video, audio, text-to-X)

  • Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
    Author: Qwen | Likes: 11,127 | Downloads: 665,513
    Flagship image-text-to-text multimodal model from the Qwen3.8 family, supporting conversational AI and visual reasoning. Trending as the most liked model of the week, with benchmark-leading vision-language performance driving widespread adoption.
  • moonshotai/Kimi-K3
    Author: moonshotai | Likes: 10,826 | Downloads: 2,226,898
    High-performance image-text-to-text multimodal model with compressed tensors for efficient deployment. Trending for its near-top weekly likes and massive download volume, valued for strong long-context and visual reasoning capabilities.
  • MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3
    Author: MiniMaxAI | Likes: 4,143 | Downloads: 2,855,539
    State-of-the-art text/image-to-video diffusion generation model supporting high-fidelity video synthesis. Trending as the leading open video generation model, with massive community adoption and a growing ecosystem of derivative fine-tunes.
  • meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B
    Author: meta-models | Likes: 1,682 | Downloads: 384,097
    30B-parameter image-text-to-text multimodal conversational model from Meta’s Muse lineup. Trending as Meta’s latest open multimodal release, competing with Qwen and DeepSeek in the mid-to-large vision-language model space.
  • Lightricks/LTX-2.5
    Author: Lightricks | Likes: 1,222 | Downloads: 503,632
    Diffusion-based video generation model supporting image-to-video, text-to-video, and video-to-video workflows. Trending for its high output quality and flexible input modalities, popular with creative professionals for video editing and generation.
  • MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-Music3
    Author: MiniMaxAI | Likes: 958 | Downloads: 11,745
    Text-to-music/audio diffusion generation model from MiniMax’s latest music AI lineup. Trending as a high-fidelity open music generation option, gaining traction among audio creators and researchers.
  • Gazingstars123/Anima-2.9B
    Author: Gazingstars123 | Likes: 248 | Downloads: 24,893
    2.9B-parameter text-to-image diffusion model optimized for English prompt understanding and high-quality visual output. Trending as a lightweight, ComfyUI-compatible image gen model for creative illustration use cases.
  • LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-3B
    Author: LiquidAI | Likes: 173 | Downloads: 9,101
    Compact 3B-parameter image-text-to-text multimodal model optimized for edge and on-device deployment. Trending as an efficient vision-language option for low-latency, local multimodal AI applications.

🔧 Specialized Models (code, math, medical, embeddings)

  • dots-studio/dots3-note-prev
    Author: dots-studio | Likes: 220 | Downloads: 1,120
    Specialized image-text-to-text multimodal model optimized for note-taking and document processing. Trending as a niche productivity-focused AI tool, catering to users needing accurate document summarization and structured note generation from mixed text/image inputs.
  • froggeric/Qwen-Fixed-Chat-Templates
    Author: froggeric | Likes: 1,255 | Downloads: 0
    Community-curated fixed Jinja chat templates for Qwen 3.5/3.8 series models, optimized for MLX inference frameworks. Trending for resolving widespread chat template compatibility issues across Qwen deployments, driving high developer engagement despite being a utility repository rather than a standalone model.

📦 Fine-tunes & Quantizations (community fine-tunes, GGUF, AWQ)

  • unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF
    Author: unsloth | Likes: 1,818 | Downloads: 3,561,466
    GGUF-quantized version of Qwen’s Qwen3.8-27B multimodal model, optimized for llama.cpp inference. Trending as the most downloaded Qwen3.8 quant, enabling lightweight deployment of the flagship multimodal model on consumer hardware.
  • Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3
    Author: Comfy-Org | Likes: 1,425 | Downloads: 14,641,908
    ComfyUI-optimized single-file distribution of MiniMax-H3, with fine-tuning for improved workflow integration. Trending as the most downloaded model in the list, enabling seamless use of MiniMax-H3 in the popular ComfyUI creative toolchain.
  • DavidAU/Qwen3.6-27B-Fable-Fusion-711-Uncensored-Heretic-NM-DAU-NEO-MAX-MTP-GGUF
    Author: DavidAU | Likes: 2,140 | Downloads: 3,020,528
    Highly customized uncensored GGUF fine-tune of Qwen 3.6 27B, optimized for creative and roleplay use cases with MTP support. Trending as one of the most popular roleplay-focused Qwen derivatives, with massive download volume.
  • Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8
    Author: Qwen | Likes: 563 | Downloads: 741,011
    Official FP8-quantized release of Qwen3.8-27B, maintaining near-full precision performance with reduced memory footprint. Trending for its official support and optimized inference on modern GPUs.
  • orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8
    Author: orcarouter | Likes: 528 | Downloads: 45,465
    Abliterated (uncensored) FP8 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B, with content restrictions removed. Trending among users seeking unfiltered multimodal interaction capabilities.
  • JonathanColetti/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF
    Author: JonathanColetti | Likes: 410 | Downloads: 558,767
    GGUF-quantized uncensored fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B with MTP (Multi-Turn Prompt) optimization. Trending for its combination of unfiltered output and broad hardware compatibility via GGUF.
  • unsloth/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF
    Author: unsloth | Likes: 481 | Downloads: 787,276
    GGUF-quantized version of Meta’s Muse-Glimmer 30B multimodal model, optimized for llama.cpp. Trending as the first widely available quant of Meta’s new multimodal release, enabling local deployment on consumer hardware.
  • lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo
    Author: lightx2v | Likes: 608 | Downloads: 300,279
    Speed-optimized fine-tune of MiniMax-H3 for faster video generation. Trending for reducing inference time while maintaining high video quality, catering to creators needing fast turnaround.
  • unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4
    Author: unsloth | Likes: 262 | Downloads: 523,919
    NVFP4-quantized version of Qwen3.8-27B optimized for NVIDIA Blackwell and Lovelace GPUs. Trending for its extreme memory efficiency and fast inference on latest NVIDIA hardware.
  • orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-MLX
    Author: orcarouter | Likes: 265 | Downloads: 0
    Uncensored MLX-optimized fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B for Apple silicon devices. Trending for enabling local unfiltered multimodal inference on Mac hardware, with high engagement despite its recent release.
  • TenStrip/10Eros-Max
    Author: TenStrip | Likes: 264 | Downloads: 0
    Adult content-focused fine-tune of MiniMax-H3 for image-text-to-video generation. Trending as a niche derivative of the popular video model, catering to adult content creators despite its recent launch.
  • Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-FP8
    Author: Qwen | Likes: 225 | Downloads: 13,344
    Official FP8-quantized release of Qwen’s 2.4T-parameter MoE text LLM. Trending for making the high-capacity MoE model more accessible for inference on mid-to-high-end GPUs.
  • HauhauCS/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive-MTP-GGUF
    Author: HauhauCS | Likes: 200 | Downloads: 27,745
    Aggressively uncensored MTP-optimized GGUF fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B multimodal model. Trending among users seeking maximally unfiltered multimodal interaction with multi-turn support.
  • Comfy-Org/MiniMax-Music-3
    Author: Comfy-Org | Likes: 177 | Downloads: 285,444
    ComfyUI-optimized single-file distribution of MiniMax-Music3 for text-to-music workflows. Trending for its easy integration with ComfyUI’s audio generation pipelines.
  • empero-ai/Qwen3.8-27B-Ridge-GGUF
    Author: empero-ai | Likes: 172 | Downloads: 12,854
    GGUF-quantized version of the Qwen3.8-27B-Ridge fine-tune, optimized for balanced performance and size. Trending as a lightweight, general-purpose Qwen3.8 multimodal quant for everyday use.

3. Ecosystem Signal

The Qwen3.8 family is the clear momentum leader in this week’s trending list, accounting for 12 of 30 entries driven by its flagship 27B multimodal model’s strong benchmark performance and a booming ecosystem of community derivatives. Open-weight models continue to dominate Hugging Face traction, with no proprietary API-only models appearing in the top 30, and open multimodal and video generation models closing the capability gap with closed alternatives.

Video generation is the fastest-growing segment: MiniMax-H3 has amassed over 17M combined downloads across its official release and ComfyUI-optimized variant, far outpacing most text model download volumes. Quantization activity is heavily concentrated on Qwen3.8-27B, with GGUF as the most popular format, alongside growing MLX (Apple silicon) and NVFP4 (NVIDIA) optimized builds, plus a robust pipeline of uncensored community fine-tunes. Sparse MoE architectures are also gaining mainstream traction, with new releases from Qwen, DeepSeek, and NVIDIA prioritizing performance-per-compute efficiency
